title: Waste of money
text: Waste of money. Honest and True: So it’s been a year and the cushion of the chair has evaporated. There is not comfort and my child is sitting on the metal frame of the chair. Notice this after about 6 months the chair started to wear down. Pay the money and find a more suitable chair for your gamer child.

product_metadata.title: X-PRO 300 Pedestal Video Rocker Gaming Chair with Bluetooth Technology
features: 2 speakers for total immersion surround sound
Easily receives audio signals from any Bluetooth-enabled device
description: Enjoy a comfortable gaming experience with the X-PRO 300 Pedestal Video Rocker Gaming Chair with Bluetooth technology. It provides a versatile seating solution that is excellent for playing video games, listening to music, watching TV, reading and relaxing. It comes equipped with two speakers that allows for total surround sound immersion so you feel closer to your favorite media. The X-PRO 300 video rocker also boasts a powerful subwoofer that utilizes Ace Bayou's innovative AFM Technology for deeper and more resonant bass. Built-in Bluetooth technology easily picks up audio signal from any enabled device.
